notes: Integer micro-USD per 1M tokens. Verified against the official pages on accessed_on. Worst-case pricing is used on purpose: DeepSeek at PEAK rates (off-peak is 50%), Qwen cached input at the full input price (real cache price is lower). Thinking/reasoning is disabled on both routes (see providers config), so max_tokens bounds all billable output.

models.comment: Tier 0<input<=32K: $0.030 in / $0.130 out per 1M. Larger prompts are refused for this route (all tokens bill at the higher tier).
DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, peak prices: cache miss $0.30, cache hit $0.006, output $1.20 per 1M. Whether max_tokens bounds thinking tokens is not stated on the page, so the route runs in non-thinking mode.
